name: Musashi-Koyama
tagline: An 800m covered shopping arcade, plus a direct line to Otemachi.
summary: Musashi-Koyama is built around Palm, an 800-metre covered shopping arcade where you can do a full shop without an umbrella. The Tokyu Meguro Line runs through onto the Toei Mita and Tokyo Metro Namboku lines, so Otemachi is a one-seat ride. Redevelopment has added residential towers and is changing the character of the area.
goodFor: People who value everyday shopping above all
People commuting to Otemachi or Meguro
People who want central access without central Tokyo prices
notFor: People optimising purely for low rent
People who want a quiet residential street
People who preferred the pre-redevelopment neighborhood
residentComment: The shopping street is the reason to live here, and it is genuinely exceptional. Being this close to Meguro without paying Meguro prices is the appeal — though redevelopment has pushed rent up from where it used to be.
